edits.old: - The masking call is inside the step and not a separate hop: a masking failure stops the item before the model call and the item keeps `ocr_status` DONE with no `predicted_type`, so the next run retries it and no unmasked text is ever sent (X3 is not used for a masking failure, because no model call was made).
edits.new:
- The masking call is inside the step and not a separate hop: a masking failure stops the item before the model call and the item keeps `ocr_status` DONE with no `predicted_type`, so the next run retries it and no unmasked text is ever sent (X3 is not used for a masking failure, because no model call was made).
- The decision record for each applied classification is a local row in the rwb_case decision-record table created by the service baseline; no DecisionRecorded event is published and no platform dependency is claimed.
